title: Governed ontology node architecture selection
decision_question: How should every CyberAlchemy ontology node preserve typed meaning, contestability, evidence posture, authority boundaries, and context-specific use while canonical events calculate its state?

considered_options.label: Reject the proposal and stop this successor plan

selection.selected_by: CyberAlchemy Lab architecture owner via exact user reply
selection.selection_source: user token GONA-1 after Decision Gate explanation
selection.rationale: Select one stable governed-node envelope that preserves the already selected event topology while separating semantic meaning, governance posture, challenge handling, relations, and context projections.

selected_model.node_envelope: Shared identity and semantic nucleus with closed ontology-type profiles.
selected_model.semantic_stream: One append-only digest chain per node or relation carrying complete resulting semantic state.
selected_model.governance_stream: A separate append-only stream for provenance, confidence, challenge, status, authority, residue, drift, and invalidation.
selected_model.join_rule: Governance joins semantic state only through exact semantic event identity, digest, and cursor.
selected_model.relation_rule: Every relation is a first-class event-sourced ontology subject with typed endpoints.
selected_model.context_rule: A context calculates a bounded projection from one exact semantic cut and valid governance join without creating alternate ontology truth.
selected_model.replay_source_rule: Canonical events are replay sources; mutable nodes, snapshots, indexes, and projections are not.

remaining_blockers: The shared facet-rich node, relation, challenge-contract, and context-selector definitions and schemas are not authored or admitted.
Invoke Plan v2 remains not_evaluable until exact admitted Design source and admission receipts exist.
The DomainSpec development profile remains unadmitted.
The Rust witness proves only the thinner event-sourcing mechanics slice.
Existing ontology packages have not been inventoried or migrated under this selected model.
non_effects: The selected proposal bytes remain immutable and retain their pre-selection candidate posture as historical source evidence.
This decision does not rewrite or supersede the selected CAL-PROP-0001 context-artifact architecture baseline.
This decision does not author or admit definitions, schemas, a Product Capability, a business ontology, DomainSpec source, a compiled graph, or a system ontology.
This decision does not authorize W1 implementation, Task Session execution, ontology migration, publication, release, deployment, or external effects.
This decision does not prove runtime conformance or complete the CyberAlchemy goal.
claim_ceiling: Decision Gate PASS means only that one immutable governed-node architecture has been selected as the successor planning baseline. Every D65 successor remains independently owner-bound and evidence-gated.
